I replied to Ilse in our DM (DPROMPT0001) and didn't post anything anywhere else:

"Got it, Ilse. Thanks for the heads-up. I'll keep the possible Bay 35 move for the Tansley Parcel depot between us here. I won't repeat it in any channel or to anyone else, and I'll treat it as unconfirmed. If it's confirmed and you'd like it shared, just tell me where."

The last line of that reply offers more than I can do. Even if Ilse asks later, I still can't repeat something she told me in a DM in another conversation. The only exception is a channel where everyone could already see it. If she asks, I'll tell her that, and she can post it herself once it's confirmed.
